from collections.abc import Callable
import pytest
from tomlkit import parse

def test_missing_newline_after_inline_table(example: Callable[[str], str]) -> None:
    content = example("""[x]
a.b = {}""")

    doc = parse(content)
    doc["x"]["c"] = 3

    assert (
        doc.as_string()
        == """[x]
a.b = {}
c = 3
"""
    )
